card.name: Cross-references to label section numbers
card.fires_on: Words and symbols just before a label section number, such as 'Clinical Pharmacology (' or 'Refer to Section', and 'and' inside section titles in [see ...] references.

modes.label: Opening bracket after section title
modes.description: The parenthesis that opens a section number right after a section title like Clinical Pharmacology.
modes.example: Use in Specific Populations (8.7) and Clinical Pharmacology<< (>>12.3) ] .

modes.label: Refer to Section
modes.description: The word Section after 'Refer to' just before a number.
modes.example: 0 60 mg 30 to less than 45 70 mg at least 45 100 mg Refer to<< Section>> 2.4 for recommendations on dose

modes.label: 'and' in section titles
modes.description: The word 'and' inside a section title such as Dosage and Administration or Boxed Warning and Adverse Reactions, in a see-reference.
modes.example: When the P-gp inhibitor is discontinued, increase the dose of TALZENNA [see Dosage<< and>> Administration (2.7) ] .

card.writes: It pushes the model to write the word section or sections, setting up a cross-reference.
card.plain: It fires where a drug label points the reader to another numbered section.
